text.tspan: The crown of a government megatower
Top view / monumental hall + a window-side player station / architectural proposal
Repeated structural bays; long views; sparse furnishings
FIVE STATIONS / SAME FRONT SERVICE LINE
STAFF GALLERY → SECURED CONNECTION TO THE CORE
Player sits at the window end; other stations extend to the right.
ONE PAINTING + TWO ARTIFACT DISPLAY BAYS
A massive, grand government hall at the top
of a megatower overlooking a fictional city.
The player can turn left to look outside.
Study a 60 × 80 m hall, about 24 m high.
Keep furniture, luggage and people believable.
Grandeur comes from the structural span.
02 PUT THE PLAYER NEAR THE GLASS
The player is at the window end of the line.
Five stations are a proposal, not a fixed count.
No neighbouring desk stands between player and city.
Forward: traveller, portal and the depth of the hall.
About 60° left: oblique window view and city below.
Camera cones here are illustrative, not control settings.
04 MOVE THE BUILDING CORE TO THE RIGHT
Public lifts arrive from lower floors.
A recessed corridor continues toward departments.
The left facade remains available for the panorama.
Maintain the monumental structure and fine materials.
Wear appears at handles, seats, labels and display cases.
Use one painting and a few world artifacts, properly held.
Unchanged in Unity: floor, PC, desk, portal, camera and gameplay.
Revision B replaces the low-floor / 28 × 30 m proposal. Dimensions, station count and poses remain blockout candidates.
